A sequence of squares is made of identical square tiles. The edge of each square is one tile length longer than the edge of the previous square. The first three squares are shown. How many more tiles does the seventh square require than the sixth?

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

Which of the following polygons has the largest area?

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

Right isosceles triangles are constructed on the sides of a \(3-4-5\) right triangle, as shown. A capital letter represents the area of each triangle. Which one of the following is true?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

The area of triangle \(XYZ\) is \(8\) square inches. Points \(A\) and \(B\) are midpoints of congruent segments \(\overline{XY}\) and \(\overline{XZ}.\) Altitude \(\overline{XC}\) bisects \(\overline{YZ}.\) The area (in square inches) of the shaded region is

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

Six cubes, each an inch on an edge, are fastened together, as shown. Find the total surface area in square inches. Include the top, bottom, and sides.

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

A corner of a tiled floor is shown. If the entire floor is tiled in this way and each of the four corners looks like this one, then what fraction of the tiled floor is made of darker tiles?

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

The polygon enclosed by the solid lines in the figure consists of \(4\) congruent squares joined edge-to-edge. One more congruent square is attached to an edge at one of the nine positions indicated. How many of the nine resulting polygons can be folded to form a cube with one face missing?

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

A semicircle of diameter \(1\) sits at the top of a semicircle of diameter \(2,\) as shown. The shaded area inside the smaller semicircle and outside the larger semicircle is called a lune. Determine the area of this lune.

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)

mappings.rationale: The midpoint segment AB gives half-height and half-base relations. Since XC is also a median, it halves the whole triangle's area. The shading can then be evaluated by triangle subtraction or the trapezoid formula.
mappings.answerReason: Let T = AB ∩ XC. Triangle XYC has area 8/2 = 4. The midpoint relations give XT = XC/2 and AT = YC/2, so triangle XAT has area 4/4 = 1. The shaded area is 4 - 1 = 3 square inches.

mappings.answerReason: Six separate unit cubes have 6·6 = 36 square inches of surface area. The pictured assembly has five face-to-face joins, so its exposed area is 36 - 2·5 = 26 square inches.

mappings.rationale: Count darker area in a complete repeating block, combining full dark squares and dark half-squares, then express that area as a fraction of the block's total area.
mappings.answerReason: A repeating 6 by 6 block contains 12 fully dark squares and 8 dark half-squares. Its dark area is 12 + 8/2 = 16 out of 36, giving 16/36 = 4/9. The matching-corner condition permits complete repeating blocks.

mappings.rationale: Test each five-square arrangement as a partial cube net, checking whether folding places its squares on five distinct cube faces without overlap.

mappings.rationale: Subtract the larger circle's segment from the smaller semicircle. The segment equals a sector minus the equilateral triangle formed by the chord and two large-circle radii.
